title: CodeAtlas Graph IR v0.2
description: The Graph IR contract between graph producers (Claude sessions, fs2ir, schema2ir) and the viewer. v0.2 widens kind vocabularies, makes locs optional and adds document title/description so Claude can author conceptual views (dataflow, control flow, architecture answers) — not just code structure. Cite locs whenever an element refers to real code: that is the audit trail. irVersion 0.1 documents remain valid.

irVersion.description: Schema version of this IR document. 0.1 documents remain valid.

commit.description: Commit hash of the analyzed repo, or null if not in a git repo.

title.description: Optional human title for this view (the question it answers). The viewer shows it in the title bar; falls back to the root node name.

description.description: Optional one-paragraph description of the view: what was included, what was cut, caveats. Shown by the viewer under the title.

root.description: ID of the root node of the graph (usually a package or module). The root is the only node without a parent; the viewer uses it as the canvas.

nodes.description: All nodes, sorted by id in UTF-8 byte order (Buffer.compare / memcmp, NOT JavaScript string order) for determinism.

edges.description: All edges, sorted by id in UTF-8 byte order for determinism. Every parent link must be mirrored by a `contains` edge from the parent to the child.

clusters.description: Named groupings of nodes, mechanical or agent-produced. Cluster ids must be unique.

nodeId.description: Stable node ID: kind prefix + fully-qualified path (never file offsets). Well-known prefixes: package, module, file, type, func (kind=function), prop (kind=property). Custom views may use any lowercase prefix (e.g. step:, store:, actor:).

loc.description: Source location, 1-based line and optional 1-based column. Paths are repo-root-relative with forward slashes (the root node's attrs.absRoot names the repo), or absolute.

col.description: Optional; defaults to 1. Ignored when opening files (file:line is the audit unit).

kind.description: Well-known kinds (package|module|file|type|function|property) get dedicated styling in the viewer; any other string is allowed for conceptual views and renders with derived styling.

parent.description: ID of the containing node. Omitted only for the root node. Parent chains must be acyclic and end at the root; each link is mirrored by a `contains` edge.

loc.description: Declaration site. For package/module nodes this points at the manifest (Package.swift) entry.

attrs.description: Extensible node attributes. Known keys are typed; producers may add more.

isCase.description: True for enum cases (kind=property with an `isCase` marker).

typeKind.description: Only meaningful for kind=type. Any string: class, struct, enum, protocol, actor, extension, interface, trait, record, …

absRoot.description: Root node only: absolute path of the directory that repo-relative locs resolve against (emitted by `codeatlas analyze` and fs2ir; used by the viewer's Open-in-editor).

scale.description: Leaf size multiplier applied by the viewer to the node's width and height (fs2ir --sizes: clamp(1 + log10(max(bytes,1)/1024)/2, 1, 2.6)). Omit for the default 1.

skipped.description: Counts of children a producer silently could not emit (fs2ir: fifo|socket|device|unreadable|ignored). Present only when at least one count is non-zero — truncation is never silent.

metrics.description: Extensible numeric metrics (e.g. loc, fanIn, fanOut, bytes).

kind.description: Well-known kinds (imports|contains|calls|references|conforms_to|inherits|instantiates|reads|writes) get dedicated styling; any other string is allowed for conceptual views. `contains` always renders as nesting, never as an arrow, and must agree with the child's `parent`.

locs.description: Every site supporting this edge (e.g. every call site). REQUIRED in spirit whenever the edge refers to real code — it is the anti-hallucination audit trail and powers click-to-source. Omit only for purely conceptual edges.

count.description: Multiplicity of the edge: number of supporting sites, or for a loc-free conceptual edge the number of times the relation occurs. When both count and locs are present they must agree (count == locs.length, checked by the validator).

annotations.description: Map from node/edge/cluster ID to an annotation object (agent- or tool-produced). Known keys are typed; any other key is allowed.

summary.description: One-paragraph explanation shown in the details panel (for the root: the view's caption).

importance.description: 0..1 salience; the viewer maps it to emphasis (edge stroke width, node prominence).

label.description: Overrides the derived label (edges: kind + count) in the viewer.

collapsedByDefault.description: Containers only: start collapsed on first load of this graph.

inferred.description: Edges only: true when the relation was inferred (dynamic dispatch, convention, reading between the lines) rather than seen at a verified loc. The viewer renders inferred edges dashed with a '?' marker — the honesty rule.

agentPatch.title: Abstraction agent patch
agentPatch.description: The only shape an agent patch may take (spec F6): clusters and/or annotations. Any patch touching nodes or edges is invalid.
